title: ButtonLoading configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.ButtonLoadingAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsLoading.description: Shows the loading spinner and blocks interaction while true.

ShowLoadingAndLabel.description: Keeps the button label visible next to the spinner; otherwise only the spinner shows while loading.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
